newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto up on DeKalb patent - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto up on DeKalb patent - analyst.

text.p: Shares of Monsanto Co rose one to 33 on prospects for increased Roundup herbicide sales after DeKalb Genetics Corp received a patent for corn that resists Roundup.
"It certainly adds some news to the story that's positive," Merrill Lynch analyst Doug Groh said.
In addition, Monsanto holds a minority stake in DeKalb.

DeKalb, a seed company, said earlier it received a U.S. patent for genetically enhanced corn that is resistant to the herbicide glyphosate, which is the active ingredient in Roundup. The corn product allows farmers to spray their fields with Roundup to kill weeds without harming the crop.
DeKalb shares were down 1-3/4 at 38 with about 48,000 shares traded, after hitting the 52-week high of 39-3/4.
